description: Comprehensive band 7.5+ preparation course. Master active test-taking strategies with lessons unlocked through your journey EXP.

lessons.title: IELTS Academic Structure & Band Descriptors
lessons.summary: Introduction to the four IELTS modules, scoring criteria, and how examiner band descriptors determine your overall score.

lessons.title: Skimming & Scanning Academic Passages
lessons.summary: Master speed reading techniques to locate topic sentences, headings, and quantitative data without getting bogged down in unfamiliar vocabulary.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1: Deciphering Charts & Graphs
lessons.summary: How to write a high-scoring 150-word report on bar charts, line graphs, and pie charts with an impactful overview statement.

lessons.title: Listening Part 1: Form Completion & Spelled Details
lessons.summary: Techniques for catching telephone numbers, addresses, British vs American names, and avoiding common distractor traps.

lessons.title: Speaking Part 1: Fluency, Range & Natural Rhythm
lessons.summary: How to answer familiar introductory questions with expanded details, idiom variety, and confident intonation.

lessons.title: Reading: True, False, Not Given Decoded
lessons.summary: The exact logical boundary between 'False' (contradicts the text) and 'Not Given' (unmentioned or speculative).

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Agree or Disagree Essays
lessons.summary: Structuring a 250-word argumentative essay: balanced viewpoint, clear thesis statement, and topic sentences supported by evidence.

lessons.title: Listening Part 2: Map & Diagram Labeling
lessons.summary: Navigating spatial layout descriptions, directional vocabulary (adjacent, opposite, corridor), and speaker orientation.

lessons.title: Speaking Part 2: Conquering the 2-Minute Cue Card
lessons.summary: One-minute note-taking strategy using the story-arc method to speak fluently for the full 120 seconds.

lessons.title: Reading: Matching Paragraph Headings
lessons.summary: Identifying the macro argument of each paragraph rather than falling for keyword matches in secondary sentences.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2: Discussion Essays & Cohesion
lessons.summary: Mastering cohesive devices, paragraph transitions, and giving both sides equal analytical depth before your conclusion.

lessons.title: Speaking Part 3: Abstract Academic Discourse
lessons.summary: Expressing abstract opinions, speculating about future societal trends, and employing academic hedges and qualifiers.
